findings.title: Date overrides bypass booking and calendar busy checks
findings.body: When a slot falls within a date override, this returns `true` before checking `busy` or `currentSeats`. Date overrides should change availability hours, not make an already-booked or calendar-busy host available. In round-robin events this can expose slots that conflict with the fixed host’s existing commitments, allowing double bookings.
